method: Similarity candidates and stem repetition read individually; same-premise or formulaic lines rewritten

revisions.old: If you could ban one type of person from public transport, who would it be?
revisions.new: Q If you could ban one behaviour from public transport, which would it be?
revisions.reason: Avoids inviting judgement of groups of people; keeps the Bold angle.

revisions.old: You can make one person in history never have been born. Do you use it?
revisions.new: S You can undo one decision a world leader made. Which decision?

revisions.old: If you could cancel one celebrity forever, who would it be and why?
revisions.new: Q Which celebrity habit should the whole world stop copying?

revisions.old: You could choose your own death date with total peace. Would you?
revisions.new: S You can know the single biggest regret you'll have at eighty. Do you want to hear it now?
revisions.reason: Removes a death-date choice that could read as self-harm adjacent.

revisions.old: If you could steal one of our partners or crushes for a day, would you?
revisions.new: Q Whose partner or crush would you trust least to keep one of our secrets?

revisions.old: If you could swap partners with one of us for a week, would you?
revisions.new: Q Whose relationship advice in this group would you never follow?

revisions.old: Romantic cooking night or a candlelit bath?
revisions.new: C Romantic cooking night or a candlelit board-game night?
revisions.reason: Keeps the everyday library clear of innuendo; adult content stays separate.

revisions.old: We can spend a whole day in bed with no interruptions. What do we do first?
revisions.new: S We get a whole lazy Sunday with no interruptions at all. What do we do first?
revisions.reason: Keeps the everyday library clear of innuendo; adult content stays separate.

revisions.old: If you could watch your own funeral, what do you hope people would say?
revisions.new: Q If a stranger summed up your life in one kind sentence, what do you hope it would be?
revisions.reason: Softened for a first conversation while keeping the Deep mood.

revisions.old: If one of us became a cult leader, what would the cult worship?
revisions.new: Q If one of us started a fan club for something ridiculous, what would it celebrate?
revisions.reason: Lighter wording for an everyday library.

revisions.old: We start a group cult around a sandwich. Which sandwich?
revisions.new: S We start a fan club devoted to one sandwich. Which sandwich wins?
revisions.reason: Lighter wording for an everyday library.
